document.title: Music to MIDI · Professional Control Surface
rail.title: Processing routes
rail.hint: Selecting a route changes configuration only. It never starts a job.
workspace.title: Audio transcription and stem workbench
workspace.copy: A dedicated inference node owns MIDI transcription and source separation while configuration, progress, auditioning and deliverables stay in this control surface.
guide.connect.title: Connect the inference node first
guide.connect.description: The frontend cannot read backend capabilities. No job will run silently or report fabricated success; verify the service URL first.
guide.source.title: Start here: add one audio file
guide.source.description: The current route is “{mode}”. Switch routes in Processing settings when needed; choosing a route never starts a job.
guide.configure.title: Audio is ready — check this job's settings
guide.configure.description: File: {file}; route: {mode}. Production defaults are ready, but the job starts only after you explicitly press the start button.
guide.submitting.title: Submitting the job to the inference node
guide.submitting.description: The start control is locked to prevent duplicate jobs. Live progress begins when the backend returns the job identifier.
guide.running.title: In progress: {stage}
guide.running.description: Progress comes from the real backend job state. Stop sends cancellation to the active analysis and rendering processes.
guide.result.separation_title: Stems are ready — you decide each next conversion
guide.result.separation_description: The WAV stems are delivered. MIDI is created only for tracks whose route you enable and explicitly start in the multitrack workbench.
guide.result.midi_description: Review BPM, track and note statistics, then download the backend-validated MIDI file.
guide.result.failed_title: The job failed — inspect the real cause
guide.result.failed_description: The result area preserves the backend error. Correct the runtime or settings before resubmitting; no fabricated artifact is produced.
guide.result.cancelled_description: No incomplete artifact was published. The backend retained the original input and settings for an explicit rerun from the result panel.
upload.title: Load an audio source
upload.hint: WAV · MP3 · FLAC · OGG · M4A · AAC · WMA
upload.dropzone_aria: Audio input area; click, press Enter, or drop a file
config.title: Route parameters
config.hint: Every parameter is submitted to the backend; the browser never simulates inference or fabricates a result.
config.backend_help: Used for full mixes and post-separation track conversion
config.yourmt3_help: Explicitly select one of five public checkpoints
config.muscriptor_help: Pinned Large / Medium / Small public weights
config.track_layout_help: Multi-track keeps model groups; single-track merges the layout
config.bpm_help: Off detects tempo automatically; on changes exported playback speed
config.compute_help: Full workflows require NVIDIA CUDA; there is no silent CPU downgrade
result.title: Processing result
result.completed: Backend inference and artifact integrity checks are complete.
result.separation_completed: The separated WAV files passed validation. MIDI conversion must be started explicitly per track below.
result.failed: The backend returned an explicit failure and published no fabricated artifacts.
result.cancelled: The job stopped without publishing incomplete artifacts.
result.failure_help: Correct the reported runtime or configuration error before submitting again.
mixer.title: Multitrack audio workbench
mixer.manual_note: Enable Convert to MIDI and choose a route, then explicitly press the conversion button on that track.
mixer.downloads: Download artifacts in the result section
track.route_ready: Route selected — waiting for explicit start
track.midi_missing: The MIDI child job published no artifact
track.select_route_first: Enable Convert to MIDI and choose a route first.
track.no_source: This track has neither a server artifact nor a local source file
dialog.title: Inference service URL
dialog.hint: The frontend accesses inference only through the versioned HTTP API. Saving runs an immediate health check.
route.smart: Send the full mix to the selected multi-instrument backend. Official MIDI-writer note events remain intact; only real tempo and meter metadata are normalized.
route.vocal_split: Leap XE and PolarFormer produce vocals and accompaniment WAV files. MIDI must be started explicitly per track.
route.six_stem_split: BS-RoFormer SW Fixed delivers six independent WAV files, then opens the shared multitrack workbench.
route.piano_transkun: Dedicated TransKun V2 piano transcription with no silent substitution by a multi-instrument route.
route.piano_transkun_v2_aug: Official TransKun V2 Aug checkpoint. The job fails explicitly when the model is unavailable.
route.piano_aria_amt: Dedicated Aria-AMT piano route. Official writer output is retained and detected tempo is written.
route.piano_bytedance_pedal: ByteDance piano transcription with sustain-pedal CC64 events preserved.
error.route_locked: A job is still active. The processing route cannot be changed.
error.event_stream: The progress channel for job {id} was interrupted; EventSource is reconnecting according to protocol.
error.read_jobs: Job history could not be read: {error}
